title: Texas Mathworks Honors Summer Math Camp
text:
Texas Mathworks Honors Summer Math Camp(HSMC) is a 6-week program in San Marcos, Texas that offers an environment where students are exposed to higher-level math. This is a multi-summer program, and returning students are given the opportunity of doing an original research project for submission to the Siemens Competition in Math, Science, and Technology

First-year students take: Elementary Number Theory, Mathematica Lab,Honors Seminar

Second-year students take: Analysis I, Combinatorics or Abstract Algebra

Third-year students take: Analysis II, Combinatorics or Abstract Algebra
